mechanism_class: closed-loop self-damage trigger economy: kit-generated damage-taken as an autonomous perpetual cast engine (CWDT-class loop)
spec_text_or_path: Ward Loop's identity: Summon Skeletons (To Dust: ~0.2s lifespan) -> minions die instantly -> Heartbound Loop rings convert each minion death into flat SELF-damage (2x420 phys) -> that self-damage exceeds the CWDT threshold -> CWDT re-casts Summon Skeletons + payload spells -> loop closes, sustained by Olroth's Resolve Ward absorb. A perpetual motion cast engine that runs at full throughput in an EMPTY ROOM. Engine has the reactive hop natively (on-damage-taken -> linked-cast, depth 1, + RETRIBUTION_ENGINE) but THREE closures are missing: (a) no minion-death -> self-damage lane (no self-hit primitive; b04 forbidden-rite steward precedent — hp_cost_scale is a COST, it does not generate trigger-feeding damage-taken events); (b) MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=1 LOCKED forbids the cyclic re-entry (the trigger's consequence regenerates its own condition — depth is unbounded); (c) Ward flat-absorb-refresh window economy only approximated. Mapped remainder = reactive CWDT chassis (grade GAPPED; player test: original needs no enemies, map does). Ladder audit: map (one trigger hop OK) -> approx (reactive-only inverts the identity) -> quantitative mint NO (depth mint is template-forbidden) -> qualitative (self-damage-generation + cyclic trigger closure = new mechanism class) -> docket. Destination: either (i) a self-damage-event primitive (kit-internal damage-taken generation) + a steward ruling on bounded loop closure, or (ii) a ruling that closed-loop autocast is out of engine scope and reactive-CWDT is the canonical approximation for the whole loop family.

mechanism_class: per-hit random element roll + per-hit random secondary-geometry roll (ACCRUAL to the elemental-hit RNG-element-pool docket)
spec_text_or_path: Wild Strike: every swing converts 100 percent phys to a RANDOM element {fire, cold, lightning} and releases that element's OWN secondary geometry (fire circle explosion / cold fork-3 wave / lightning chain 4-7); prismatic tag forbids repeats. This is the SECOND corpus instance of the per-attack-random-element-from-pool gap the poe1-elemental-hit docket filed and explicitly asked the steward to watch for ('Related PoE kits sharing an RNG-element substrate (e.g. Wild Strike...) may accrue'). Wild Strike is gapped WORSE than Elemental Hit: (a) no pruning endpoint exists — there is no Combat Focus analog deleting elements, so there is NO meta endpoint where the build itself collapses to mono (the un-curated roulette IS the kit; the Trinity variant actively REWARDS cycling all three); (b) the roll also selects among three secondary GEOMETRIES, so a geometry-roll primitive would be needed on top of the element-roll primitive. Steward: consolidate with the poe1-elemental-hit family docket; accrual note for the mint decision — this kit is negative=1 trap-canon (death_class extrinsic-no-lever), i.e. the roulette pattern's second exemplar is a community-confirmed trap, which is evidence about the pattern's player-value, not just its mappability. Ladder audit: map -> approx (fixed fire + one fixed secondary = not that build) -> quantitative NO -> qualitative candidate already filed by the elemental-hit docket -> accrue, do not duplicate-mint.

mechanism_class: self-supplied sacrificial victim-entities: flask-spawned HOSTILE fodder as guaranteed proc-target ammunition
spec_text_or_path: Wormblaster's attested invariant (dossier conf 0.72-0.82, stable across ALL documented era-variants): The Writhing Jar flask spawns 2 HOSTILE worms at the player; the worms are enemies, so they 'interact with any on-hit and on-kill effects' — the build farms its OWN victims to fuel proc economies (CoC machine-gun, Slayer overleech, Herald pops) precisely where real targets are scarce (bosses). Engine gap: proxies are ALLIES (PROXY family), and trigger grammar conditions consume REAL combat events; no lane supplies synthetic hostile targets on demand. The reactive trigger half (on-crit -> linked-cast) is native; the fodder SUPPLY is the identity and has no lane — the kit's name is the worms. Family note: 5th member of the recurring 'entity as a consumable resource pool' gap family (animate-weapon ground-items-as-summon-fuel; bladefall field-as-detonation-queue; dark-pact proxy-life-as-ammo; detonate-dead corpse-as-ammo) — here inverted to hostile-side: spawn-to-kill rather than spawn-to-spend. Steward consolidation of the family should include this row. CONFIDENCE CAVEAT (weakest-facts kit in batch-08): the promoted mechanics claim (CoC+Barrage+Pathfinder) is UNSUPPORTED at verify (sources 403'd; 3.3-era variant shows Slayer+Flameblast instead) and the kit is NOT promoted — the gap is filed on the flask-worm invariant only, which every attested variant shares; re-examine per heavy-strike-stun precedent if a deeper dossier lands. Ladder audit: map (trigger grammar OK for the proc half) -> approx (CoC-without-worms = generic crit-proc build, identity lost) -> quantitative NO (no fodder-count param exists to widen) -> qualitative (synthetic-victim-supply primitive, evidence-gated) -> docket.
